props.title: Making a Difference
props.content: We believe in giving back to the community and environment that sustains us. Our initiatives focus on empowering farmers, protecting the environment, and building stronger rural communities across Bangladesh.

initiatives.title: Farmer Buy Back Program
initiatives.description: Supporting farmers by purchasing crops at fair prices, ensuring stable income and market access.

initiatives.title: Green Bangladesh Afforestation
initiatives.description: Large-scale tree plantation initiative to combat climate change and restore ecological balance.

initiatives.title: Farmer Training Workshop
initiatives.description: Educational workshops empowering farmers with modern agricultural techniques and best practices.
objectives: Introduce new technologies to rural communities
